ar.title: طاجن حوصلات بالخضار (طاجن عوانص)

steps.n1: اسلق الجزر والبطاطس والبسلة سلقاً خفيفاً في ماء مملح وصفّها. قطّع الجزر شرائح رفيعة والبطاطس مكعبات.
steps.n3: اخلط النشا والبهارات المشكلة بمرقة الحوصلات المتبّلة جيداً وصبّها فوقها.
steps.n4: اخبز في فرن متوسط الحرارة مُسخَّن مسبقاً لمدة 30–40 دقيقة.

en.title: Gizzard and Vegetable Casserole (Tagin ‘Awanis)
en.intro: Recipe 185, page 84 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Parboil the carrots, potatoes and peas in salted water and drain. Slice the carrots thinly and dice the potatoes.
steps.n2: Put the vegetables and gizzards in a casserole.
steps.n3: Stir the cornflour and mixed spices into the well-seasoned gizzard broth and pour it over.
steps.n4: Bake in a moderate, preheated oven for 30–40 minutes.

legacySteps: Parboil the carrots, potatoes and peas in salted water and drain. Slice the carrots thinly and dice the potatoes.
Put the vegetables and gizzards in a casserole.
Stir the cornflour and mixed spices into the well-seasoned gizzard broth and pour it over.
Bake in a moderate, preheated oven for 30–40 minutes.
